posts.title: My Sailfish OS Journey: Apps for my daily needs
posts.description: I have been daily driving Sailfish OS since 2014, and that has been made possible by the many apps I rely on. In the first post of this series, I elaborated on where Sailfish OS comes from, and on how I got to using it. In this post, I’ll cover what apps I value most, and the quirks that come with them.
